ITEM 1 | Pizza slice in the upper right: a wedge with a thick, golden-yellow melted cheese top showing light browning spots and reddish-orange sauce edges along the crust side; the cheese is glossy and holds its shape, with a crust of about 2.5 cm thick visible at the wide end; footprint roughly 12 x 8 cm on a plate about 26 cm across | 130
ITEM 2 | Leafy green salad mound in the center-left: crisp, torn romaine-type leaves in pale yellow-green and darker green tones, coated with a creamy, pale off-white dressing with a slight sheen; scattered small golden-brown toasted bread croutons about 1-2 cm and small flakes of pale grated cheese; footprint roughly 10 x 9 cm, piled about 3 cm high | 110
ITEM 3 | Creamy dressing or sauce: pale off-white, semi-glossy coating clinging to the lettuce and chicken, with some pooling along the lettuce base; soft, flowing, no clear boundary | 15
ITEM 4 | Grilled chicken pieces at lower right: cut into irregular bite-sized chunks about 2-3 cm, pale cream-beige interior with light golden-brown edges and faint char marks, moist and slightly shiny, with chopped green herb flecks and a dark green smear on the plate edge; footprint roughly 8 x 6 cm, about 2 cm high | 95
ITEM 5 | Pizza crust or bread base under the slice at right: pale golden-tan, soft-looking bread layer with a slightly darker browned edge, partially hidden beneath the pizza and chicken, roughly 7 x 4 cm | 30
